{{Top|leg}}
'''Exemplar''' was a title in use by the [[Outcasts (Kashyyyk)|Outcasts]] of [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]]. It was reserved for only their highest ranking members. One such individual, [[Zheus]], held the title in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
It is possible for the player to be awarded this title in the form of a "badge" in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''
